list: Official 55-trophy list as published by PlayStation
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Guides are my own wording for this entry, drawn from the official descriptions plus the launch-era guides cited beside each trophy. GTA VI released 19 November 2026, so a few exact triggers are still unconfirmed in the cited guides and are flagged as such instead of invented.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Follow the roadmap stages in order so the long collectible hunts start early instead of stacking up at the end.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission, through to the end. It is the first mission of the story, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies arrive in order as the story moves — just keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story-only — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story-only — the chapter trophy unlocks at the end of its last mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 — the last chapter trophy before the finale. Story-only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the campaign. This gold trophy is the story's finish line — save before the last mission, stock up, then play it through.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up in the story — play it to the end and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission — follow the plan, take the score, and get out clean.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It arrives in the story's flow — no side requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play it through to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges all feed the percentage. The in-game stats page shows what is left; this is the last trophy for most players, so save it for the end and mop up with this guide's checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and spins all add to the running total shown in stats. Farm them on long highway runs and big jumps instead of chasing one spot.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once (nine types per PowerPyx: races, shooting range, fishing, drone races, arcade, bowling and the rest). Sample each one early so you know where they all are.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's weapon and par time; gold needs clean, fast runs, so practise the slow ones first and repeat the rest.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location (14 per PowerPyx). Learn each course's racing line; one win per location is enough, so move on as soon as a location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race you win for the first time counts, so work through the race list instead of replaying one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish where Cal fishes and watch the tension meter — steady reeling beats fast reeling.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — any cabinet, any game, start to finish.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Contact strands unlock through the story; keep checking for Andy's calls and play his missions as they appear.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's strand to its final mission and complete it. Like the other contact finales, the strand's missions appear as the story advances — do them when they show up rather than leaving them all for the end.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's strand to its final mission and complete it. Watch the map for Billy's missions and play them as they appear so the finale is waiting after the campaign.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as map icons as you explore — clear them as you find them, since later chapters open new areas and new strangers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand to its final mission and complete it. The strand's missions appear as the story advances; play them as they come.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's strand to its final mission and complete it. The fifth of the side-character finales; like the others, it only needs the strand played through to its end.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations per PowerPyx. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is only offered in the morning after the mission Down to Earth, and it goes away once Chapter 1 ends — do it before the story moves on. Track your count under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which only opens after the story lets you play them together.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt opens; the animal is a one-off, so take the shot when it appears.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and track sets in the checklist. Each set needs every card in it, so this is a long hunt across the map.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The counter ticks per location, so tag new spots as you travel rather than backtracking at the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving and world activities — the in-game challenge list shows progress, so clear the easy ones first and let the rest land while you chase other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, hit a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight and hide until it cools.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the pace up, and don't let the cops drop — if the stars clear, the chain resets.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride anything new and the counter rises. Try car parks, traffic and missions to meet new models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger focus, and chain the shots — crowded fights are the place to try.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport — take an aircraft out without following the normal route. Exact trigger unconfirmed: try departing in a stolen plane from the runway and check the cited guides once more players confirm it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Something to do with Rhinos (tanks). Exact trigger unconfirmed — the description is a joke, not instructions; it most likely involves a tank encounter, so try the military hardware when it shows up and check the cited guides once the trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt is void — leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the getaway before the robbery, not after, since the escape is half the requirement.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, crack it, grab the cash and break away fast.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida (52 areas per the guides). The map fills in as you travel — sweep the state region by region and watch for grey patches during cleanup.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang (9 gangs per the guides). Each gang's operation is a separate hit — work through the gangs one at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachfront bar spot, order a drink and enjoy the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through the showroom glass and out the other side.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through on your throw. It also counts as trying an activity type for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. Exact trigger unconfirmed — it most likely lands on a partner moment in the campaign, so play the story and watch for it rather than hunting it as a side task.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse. Exact trigger unconfirmed — the game tracks choices (PSNProfiles notes a count behind it), so keep choosing as the story offers them and it should land in normal play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Exact trigger unconfirmed — it reads like a retry: fail something, then succeed on the second attempt. Play the story and let it come.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Exact trigger unconfirmed — most likely a random world event or easter egg; keep an eye out for strange encounters while exploring.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle into a pedestrian. Exact method unconfirmed; a slow drive-by past foot traffic is the way to try it. The name is a bowling pun — it is not about the bowling alley.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — hand them to contacts over time until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles, clothes and weapons all add up, and it usually pops while you buy gear anyway.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all garage properties (8 per the guides). Garages go on sale as you progress — buy each one when it appears.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app and register them — stolen and found rides both count.
